evidenceLevel: Registration is counted from createApp({ skipDb: true }) plus mountApiRoutes, the same assembly as apps/api/src/index.ts. Runtime exercise is docs/architecture/http-coverage.json, written by apps/api/src/http-coverage.integration.test.ts from actual requests. Do not hand-edit executed flags.
phase4Scope: Every route in this inventory, including unwired and legacy writes and import operations. Grouping is allowed. Lack of a frontend caller is not a reason to skip. Use isolated disposable fixtures. Record an explicit reason when a route is not executed.
countMethod: Unique method plus full path after the mount prefix. Counted from handler registrations in apps/api/src. SPA HTML and /assets static middleware are excluded. Helpers such as planNode, applyStep and getJson are not endpoints.
dynamicRegistration: None. Prefixes are static app.route calls. registerCommercialWriteRoutes and registerCommercialIngressRoutes add fixed POST/GET lists.

processRegistration.productionEntry: apps/api/src/index.ts uses createApp({ skipDb: true }) and then mountApiRoutes once.
processRegistration.libraryEntry: apps/api/src/app.ts calls the same mountApiRoutes when skipDb is false. The coverage suite uses skipDb true plus mountApiRoutes, matching the process entry. One process does not mount both copies.
processRegistration.health: GET /health and GET /api/health are always registered inside createApp.
